name: auto-sort-tabs
description: Automatically groups tabs into native tab groups and keeps them sorted.

scripts.lint: npm run build && web-ext lint --source-dir dist
scripts.run:chrome: npm run build && web-ext run --target chromium --source-dir dist
scripts.run:firefox: npm run build && web-ext run --source-dir dist
scripts.pack: npm run build && web-ext build --source-dir dist --artifacts-dir artifacts --overwrite-dest
